properties.description: The CONTRACT is checked, not the judgement. skill_lint asserts detect-and-ask states all of it: offer a reading; carry what would change it; present the options as a SELECTABLE list; put the RECOMMENDATION FIRST and mark it; give every option its consequence including the ones not recommended; and answer in the USER'S language, stated language-independently. Plus two negative checks that are the load-bearing half: NO served text hardcodes English as the answer language (so the rule cannot be implemented as English-only — the trap Anthony named), and NO requirement status, decision status or gap acknowledgement is written in the same act as a recommendation. Whether a recommendation is GOOD, and whether the language was correctly matched, are semantic and stay evidenced by trials — deliberately no LLM evals in CI. PLANNED.
properties.name: The contract of how a choice is put to the user is checked; the judgement is not
